document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
When you see the mouth of a cave, you can scarcely believe 
your eyes. You plunge inside and discover that the cave is deep 
enough to save you from the smoke and heat.

The  next  day  you  emerge  into  a  devastated  wasteland,  a 
catastrophe.  Your  personal  grief  overwhelms  you  and  your 
scientific  curiosity  is  exhausted.  Your  only  desire  is  to  leave 
the smoldering landscape and you make your way to the outer 
world via the stream-cut fissure.
